verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an IT-automation and device-management platform, so the axis applies. The pack shows only bulk operations via APIs and PowerShell, plus event-driven onboarding and offboarding workflows. These are one-off or triggered actions, not a documented recurring schedule. Nothing describes the product scheduling jobs or workflows on a recurring basis, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
